notes.title: First Expansion Pack
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

A new adventure awaits! This expansion pack improves on everything that makes the base game fun and brings in many new ideas and features to keep you entertained for hours. 

[h1]New campaign[/h1]

The campaign consists of six handcrafted chapters and you will find 16 levels in each of them. Every chapters starts with simple levels and gradually moves to much more difficult challenges.

Demonstrate your mastery over the world of Cubiscape by completing the whole campaign!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/86f4afb85cff40e3d7ca9953c4ba14c071634b40.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/7e18417fabfb03991afae430c64997e26f008825.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]New puzzle elements[/h1]

The first four chapters of the campaign each focus on one of the new puzzle elements - be it the "rewinder", falling ground or the new "vertical" enemy ("wolf" in our nature theme!). You will be gradually introduced to how the element works and then given increasingly harder puzzles to solve. Be prepared!

But don't worry, if you find yourself stuck there is always the possibility to get a hint ːsteamhappyː

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/aa93cdcf012bbf475e797668ac6ac4ed1ccb061a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/fee04f7731bc5030a19bca530e0cf3868acf498e.png[/img][/url]

The four new elements are:
[olist]
[*] [b]Falling ground[/b] - [spoiler]falls down after someone walks over it, making it impossible to walk over it again[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Vertical enemy [/b]- [spoiler]same as regular enemy ("red cube/fox") but prefers vertical movement over horizontal[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Rewinder[/b] - [spoiler]moves any character back to its starting point and removes any buffs (shields, speed...)[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Blue Wall[/b] - [spoiler]you can move this wall up or down whenever you like![/spoiler]
[/olist]

Which one do you find the most interesting? Let us know!

[h1]Unlimited creativity[/h1]

Want to play around with the new puzzle elements yourself? Then open the editor and create your own levels or play those created by the community.

We are eager to see what are you able to come up with!

[h1]Achievements and skins[/h1]

With the new campaign come new achievements. Progress in the campaign to earn them!

Don't forget to check out two brand new skins - "The Brain" and "The Thinker" . These come without any rank requirements so make sure to try them out ːsteamhappyː

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/e183c18c8a4b7edfbbca6236d65ee8a51bad3410.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/00c3e27b612d62449bd39e283d1a596216592bd0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Other[/h1]

The release of this expansion pack brings also some changes and improvements to the base game:
[list]
[*] new batch of randomly generated levels with [b]better balanced difficulty[/b]
[*] slightly improved visuals for various ingame elements
[*] improved and [b]simplified UI[/b] navigation
[*] other small bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.content:
[h1]Nature theme![/h1]

As a small surprise we have created a "[i]nature[/i]" theme that will [b]turn all levels into neat little forests[/b] filled with traps, foxes and bears! All the different [b]animals are animated[/b] to bring a little bit more life into the game. An update with this will is now available for everyone and you can switch to the new theme in settings. 

We have also tweaked the apperance of a few elements in the original theme - the biggest change being the addition of gray sides to the fast red cube (see bellow) which should hopefully make it much easier to recognize (especially for our visually impaired players!).

For those of you who are eager to try the theme out, here is a little [b]visual guide[/b] to make the transition easier:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/c0e5a0c8d00e358b335dabe6227c3c5d982d08ab.png[/img]

And don't worry, the [b]mechanics of the game are still the same[/b]! You will of course be able to use the classic "[i]cubes[/i]" theme if you want - it's entirely up to you! Let us know in the comments what you think about the new theme. Thank you!

notes.title: November Update
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]

As promised in our updates roadmap we are releasing our first major content update for Cubiscape 2. See bellow for what you will find in this release. We are also [b]looking for more feedback[/b] so we know what to focus on in future updates. [b]We read every comment and review[/b] - your opinion is very valuable to us!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/91050dd13aea8758154576debf9afc97588c4b6d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/31db926391cec8857d5b063299680680074ba785.jpg[/img][/url]

This was the [b]most requested feature[/b] by far so we are pleased to announce that now you can [b]earn over 20 achievements[/b] by playing the main campaign and solving random puzzles!

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/2aa0146a2fe9fe86972b74ae00bba08e838a0739.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/0f86957e53ad2b223bd523fead1ffb5018279f49.png[/img][/url]

To bring a bit of competitiveness to random levels we are introducing the Leaderboard feature that will track the most capable players across all platforms. You will find the leaderboards directly in the "Random" menu. There is a separate table for each of the four difficulties. Those players that solve the most levels in the last 7 days will appear in the leaderboards - so go out there and earn those bragging rights!

[b]Note:[/b] this feature is still in Beta and we will be closely monitoring it for any potential problems. The leaderboards update roughly every hour, so it might take some time before you see your latest score.

[h3]New (sort of) campaign chapters[/h3]

As promised the campaign got two more chapters added to it. Unfortunately we rolled out this feature a week earlier than intended and the quality of the content was not up to par. We apologize for that. This is now resolved - and don't worry, if you already completed some (or all!) of the levels, you will not lose your progress.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Better tutorial
[*] General UI improvements
[*] Several other under the hood fixes
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

That's it for today. We are already working on more improvements to the game and will be ready to share more details in the coming weeks. Stay tuned!
